results.title: Kuduz
results.overview: In a village in rural Turkey, young Murat discovers the family dog has rabies and sets it loose rather than let his father put it down. His act of mercy turns father against son, and a household held together by silence begins to come apart.

results.title: Tag
results.overview: At a party, Ana (30) runs into Dida (60), someone from her past. Ana’s desire to talk about "what happened" clashes with Dida’s refusal, escalating the conflict between them until it spirals out of control.

results.title: Mugalim
results.overview: Zhandos, a music teacher, lives in the small town of Balkhash and dreams of moving to a big city. He is loved by his students, and the school turns a blind eye to his side jobs. When a patron nostalgic for his hometown arrives, Zhandos is given the chance to leave and must decide what matters more: the art within him, or himself within art.

results.title: Family Wanted
results.overview: The film revolves around Farouk (Karim Abdel Aziz), a supermarket manager who is too busy to attend to his home, his wife Mai (Yasmine Sabri), and his children. His wife’s unemployed brother, Galal (Mostafa Khater), moves in with the family, completely turning Farouk's life upside down and dragging him into seemingly unsolvable predicaments—all set against a backdrop of comedy.

results.title: Europiano (2/2)  - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
results.original_title: Europiano (2/2) - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
results.overview: In the second part of this magnificent concert celebrating music from across Europe, Lukas Sternath, Martha Argerich, Bruce Liu and Hayato Sumino perform the finest piano concertos by Beethoven, Schumann, Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

results.title: Wedding Rehearsal
results.overview: Tamara, with a child from a marriage that did not last long, is from an impoverished aristocratic family. To save her family from bankruptcy, Tamara is to marry Hassan Al-Dabbah, owner of one of the largest meat empires in the Middle East. Despite his wealth, Hassan comes from a nouveau riche family. Shortly before the wedding, the families spend a week together to oversee the wedding preparations. The differences between the families becomes apparent, and behind the fake smiles, all parties supervise the final wedding details. These details are overseen by Omar, Tamara's old love, who has created a rock sculpture to give a unique character to the wedding. This sculpture will become the source of several disputes during the wedding.

results.title: Chili Finger
results.overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

results.title: Merantau
results.overview: When 18-year-old Nova has just arrived in the Netherlands, she can’t call her worried mother as promised. What should have been a simple run to the store turns into a long journey in search of connection.

results.title: Tutt Paini English Ne
results.overview: Blending comedy with heartfelt family moments, this movie explores the clash between cultural pride and modern aspirations through characters every Punjabi household will recognise.

results.title: Dutch GP: Tegen Alle Verwachtingen In
results.original_title: Dutch GP: Tegen Alle Verwachtingen In

results.title: Sweet Nothing
results.overview: As Jack Bledsoe embarks on a journey to find and book a Drag Queen, his internalized homophobia begins to unravel his relationship with his partner and with himself.

results.title: The Optimist
results.overview: Herbert Heller keeps his experience as a teenage boy surviving in Auschwitz hidden from his family. Until he meets Abby, a young teenager whose own brush with pain and death inspires him to open up as well, leading the two of them to exchange their stories as a meaningful and healing friendship is born.

results.title: Canada Day
results.overview: At a dive bar on Canada Day, a 21-year-old named Aria sparks a romantic connection with the very actress she caused to be cancelled for 6 years prior.

results.title: White Lightning
results.overview: WHITE LIGHTNING is a gritty, funny, and uniquely American story about second chances, legacy, and what it takes to outrun your past. This feature-length documentary follows 18-year-old sprinter King Combest as he attempts to break his father’s 25-year-old national high school record–and the cycle of drugs, jail, and poverty that has shaped his Kentucky family for generations. King’s father Casey (aka “White Lightning”) was once an elite sprinter destined for Olympic greatness before a marijuana arrest derailed his career and left him working as a janitor on the margins of society. As King chases his father’s iconic record, it becomes clear that the real stakes are far greater: becoming the first man in the Combest family to earn a college degree and forging a path beyond a legacy of crime and addiction.

results.title: American Baby
results.overview: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.

results.title: PINBALL
results.overview: In a contemplative coming of age portrait, PINBALL follows Yosef, a spirited athlete, in Louisville, Kentucky as he dives into the memories of his journey from Iraq to America and what it means to chase his dreams in the shadow of a war that displaced his family from their Iraqi homeland.

results.title: Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain! Fun on the Run
results.original_title: भाभीजी घर पर हैं! फ़न ऑन द रन
results.overview: Two rival neighbors and their wives embark on a chaotic road trip, encountering two eccentric brothers who transform their journey into a hilarious adventure full of mishaps and unexpected twists.

results.title: King Kaew
results.overview: After a child in her care dies, a young woman is executed for a crime she didn't commit. Now, her spirit seeks justice for her wrongful death.

results.title: I, Nobody
results.overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

results.title: The Singers
results.overview: An impromptu singing contest at a dive bar turns a lonely night into a soul-baring moment of shared harmony.
